'''Matthew Moghadam The Destiny Deck''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Matthew Moghadam]]
* '''Published:''' October 1996 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - A New Hope]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' —
* '''Strategy:''' The Destiny Deck
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PANH The Destiny Deck Moghadam LS 1996.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

This is the light side version of this deck and I have also made a dark side. It is a fairly expensive deck, but you can destroy these sad, stormtroopers using this deck in an instant.

Just play with this deck and I guarantee that you will win. Oh, and I consider myself the best CCG player on earth. If you challenge me, email me at blkhawk@primenet.com and we will play. Also, please send any feedback.
